title: Restrict access to Tomcat configuration directory
description: The Tomcat $CATALINA_HOME/conf directory contains Tomcat configuration files. It is recommended that the ownership of this directory be tomcat_admin:tomcat. Reads $CATALINA_BASE (default /opt/tomcat) and $CATALINA_HOME (default: $CATALINA_BASE); set them for packaged installs (e.g. CATALINA_BASE=/var/lib/tomcat10, CATALINA_HOME=/usr/share/tomcat10). XML comments are ignored. The expected owner/group are tomcat_admin:tomcat as in the benchmark; override with TOMCAT_OWNER / TOMCAT_GROUP.

title: Ensure 'sslProtocol' is Configured Correctly for Secure Connectors
description: The TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 protocols should be disabled via the sslProtocol directive. The TLSv1.0 protocol is vulnerable to information disclosure and both protocols lack support for modern cryptographic algorithms including authenticated encryption. The only SSL/TLS protocols which should be allowed are TLSv1.2 and the newer TLSv1.3 protocol. Every Connector with SSLEnabled="true" must set sslProtocol (on the Connector or its SSLHostConfig, also accepting protocols=) to TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3 or TLSv1.2+TLSv1.3. Compliant when no TLS connector exists. Reads $CATALINA_BASE (default /opt/tomcat) and $CATALINA_HOME (default: $CATALINA_BASE); set them for packaged installs (e.g. CATALINA_BASE=/var/lib/tomcat10, CATALINA_HOME=/usr/share/tomcat10). This is generally regarded as stronger authentication than a password as it requires the client to have the certificate and not just know a password. At least one Connector/SSLHostConfig must require client certificates (clientAuth="true" or certificateVerification="required"). Reads $CATALINA_BASE (default /opt/tomcat) and $CATALINA_HOME (default: $CATALINA_BASE); set them for packaged installs (e.g. CATALINA_BASE=/var/lib/tomcat10, CATALINA_HOME=/usr/share/tomcat10). XML comments are ignored.

title: Application specific logging
description: By default, java.util.logging does not provide the capabilities to configure per-web application settings, only per VM. In order to overcome this limitation Tomcat implements JULI as a wrapper for java.util.logging. JULI provides additional configuration functionality so you can set each web application with different logging specifications. Counts applications in $CATALINA_BASE/webapps without WEB-INF/classes/logging.properties; expects 0. Reads $CATALINA_BASE (default /opt/tomcat) and $CATALINA_HOME (default: $CATALINA_BASE); set them for packaged installs (e.g. CATALINA_BASE=/var/lib/tomcat10, CATALINA_HOME=/usr/share/tomcat10). XML comments are ignored.
reference: CIS Apache Tomcat 10.1 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 7.1 Application specific logging

title: Ensure className is set correctly in context.xml
description: Ensure the className attribute is set to AccessLogValve. The className attribute determines the access log valve to be used for logging. Counts applications whose META-INF/context.xml has no AccessLogValve; expects 0. Reads $CATALINA_BASE (default /opt/tomcat) and $CATALINA_HOME (default: $CATALINA_BASE); set them for packaged installs (e.g. CATALINA_BASE=/var/lib/tomcat10, CATALINA_HOME=/usr/share/tomcat10). title: Rename the manager application
description: The manager application allows administrators to manage Tomcat remotely via a web interface. The manager application should be renamed to make it harder for attackers or automated scripts to locate. Counts conf/Catalina/localhost/manager.xml, webapps/host-manager/manager.xml and webapps/manager; expects 0 (the manager is renamed or removed). Reads $CATALINA_BASE (default /opt/tomcat) and $CATALINA_HOME (default: $CATALINA_BASE); set them for packaged installs (e.g. CATALINA_BASE=/var/lib/tomcat10, CATALINA_HOME=/usr/share/tomcat10). XML comments are ignored. CIS marks this recommendation Manual; the automated check implements its audit procedure.
reference: CIS Apache Tomcat 10.1 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 10.5 Rename the manager application

Every Connector must set connectionTimeout explicitly to 1-60000 ms (the benchmark example is 60000; tune lower for your load). Reads $CATALINA_BASE (default /opt/tomcat) and $CATALINA_HOME (default: $CATALINA_BASE); set them for packaged installs (e.g. CATALINA_BASE=/var/lib/tomcat10, CATALINA_HOME=/usr/share/tomcat10).
